claims.statement: Pinned hierarchy guide declares FPT/GHEC/GHES, conditional on organization using sub-issues. Parent and progress hidden fields display issue relationships and progress; display is not authority to modify hierarchy or proof feature available on target.
Parent field supports grouping and selecting/filtering particular issue with owner/repository/number. Full identity is required; same issue number across repositories must not be conflated.

Source parent filter describes items that are sub-issues of selected parent but does not define transitive descendants, inaccessible parents or multiple levels. Do not certify full hierarchy coverage or absence from filtered view.

Progress field shows how many sub-issues completed; source does not define denominator, nested aggregation, excluded/deleted/inaccessible items, completion reason or acceptance criteria. Displayed completion must not certify independently accepted engineering work.
Enabling fields uses table hidden-field menu. No native change, hierarchy mutation, accepted controls or rights clearance; linked layout/filter references remain separately reviewed.
Pinned type-field guide declares FPT/GHEC/GHES and applies when organization uses issue types. Bug/task/feature are examples, not exhaustive required taxonomy or proof actual target configuration.
Enabling Type through table hidden-field menu displays organizational issue classification. Source does not describe changing type, permission matrix, synchronization or automation effects.

Source supplies no requirement that every issue has a type, nor empty-cell semantics for PRs/drafts/foreign issues or restricted data. Missing display cannot become policy violation or passing inapplicability without scoped evidence.
Linked organization type-management guide is separate evidence. No classification changed, fields enabled, accepted policy, rights clearance or native assurance.
